title: Room floor coverage
description: Sweep the free floor of a 4 m x 3 m room with a sofa and a table, using a 30 cm cleaning tool, within 180 seconds. Scored on the percentage of free floor area swept. The goal is the whole free floor; a robot vacuum, a coverage planner or a person with a stick vacuum can be scored against it. People use different means here, so the task makes no robot-versus-person comparison.
